name: west-east-houses
integration_notes: Synchronous build(ctx) returns a THREE.Group; local houses.js is required beside component.js.
Buildings and attached stone entrance steps only; parent network is included exclusively by preview.js.
Footings extend below the ground datum for terrain contact.
Complete backs, gables, two-sided solid roof assemblies and embedded masonry chimneys verified from four compass directions.
No road changes and no writes to inherited camera, manifest, parents or siblings.
